title: Token Transformation Pipelines with Style Dictionary & Design Sync
subtopicTitle: Token Transformation Pipelines with Style Dictionary & Design Sync
problemStatement:
Automating cross-platform token compilation to CSS variables, SCSS, TypeScript declarations, Android XML, and iOS Swift using Style Dictionary v4.

**Enterprise Importance**:
Senior developers must build resilient CI/CD pipelines that pull design changes from Figma/GitHub, validate them, and distribute compiled token packages with zero manual copy-pasting.
interviewTrap: Manually updating CSS variables when designs change, leading to token drift between Figma libraries and code.

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: Tokens in JSON -> Style Dictionary Parses & Filters -> Transforms (px to rem, hex to oklch) -> Formats (CSS, TS, iOS, Android) -> Artifacts published to npm and mobile repositories.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Design Token Layer: Primitives, semantic aliases, and component tokens established.
2. Component Architecture: Headless state and keyboard accessibility hooks implemented.
3. Styling & Cascade: Zero-runtime CSS variables and layer specificity managed.
4. Governance & Packaging: Tree-shaking, semantic versioning, and telemetry monitored.

complexity.time: O(1) CSS variable resolution at paint time / zero JavaScript runtime overhead
complexity.space: O(1) bundle footprint per imported component
